title: Facebook reports positive earnings despite recent controversies
text: Facebook reports positive earnings despite recent controversies Thursday, 31 January 2019 ( 20 hours ago ) Facebook reported that its revenue grew by 30% to $16.2 billion in the fourth quarter. The company's monthly active users rose 9% to 2.3 billion people . CNET senior producer Dan Patterson joined CBSN to discuss Facebook's growth amid recent data and privacy controversies. ▶ Data Scandals Are Old News for Investors Looking to Cash In on Facebook 01:55 Facebook's year of scandal is a thing of the past ー at least according to Wall Street, Meridian Equity Partners' Jonathan Corpina told Cheddar. Wall Street's positive response to Facebook's impressive earnings show 2018's scandals are old news, Corpina said. "That's an old story; we are in 2019...
